##### Project general facts

Palm Central Private Residences - Frond D is a residential development by Nakheel, formed by a group of buildings that rise in a series of steps. Layered façades give the buildings depth, broad terraces define the upper levels, and floor-to-ceiling glazing opens each home to panoramic views over the sea and the cove. The collection includes one- to five-bedroom apartments, four-bedroom townhouses and penthouses. Select three-, four- and five-bedroom apartments come with large terraces, while the townhouses have double-height living areas and private terraces that extend onto the landscaped deck and the beach. Some residences also include a private garage and a maid's room.

Shared amenities are arranged around landscaped gardens that lead down to the beach. Leisure facilities include an infinity pool with an upper terrace, a beach lounge, an event lawn and an outdoor BBQ area. For sport and wellness, residents have a padel court, beach volleyball, a sports area and an outdoor fitness zone, along with an indoor gym with a fitness studio and a yoga studio. Families can use both indoor and outdoor kids' play areas. A clubhouse, a games room and a lobby lounge add indoor space for gathering, and layered planting with defined pathways frames the approach to each entrance.

Interiors follow a restrained design language built on natural tones, tactile materials and precise detailing. Open living areas flow directly onto private terraces and balconies, and full-height glazing brings daylight deep into the rooms. Kitchens are open to the living and dining space and are arranged around a central island, while bathrooms feature double vanities and bathtubs with glass shower screens. The four-bedroom residences use a refined palette of contemporary finishes, the townhouses pair double-height volume with expansive glazing towards the coastal landscape, and the penthouses add separate dining rooms and broad private terraces facing the sea.

##### Location description and benefits

Palm Jebel Ali is a palm-shaped island on the Arabian Gulf coast of Dubai, planned as a destination that brings together homes, hospitality, leisure and generous open spaces. Its masterplan includes a community centre with a mosque, a sports and wellness centre and parks, alongside private frond neighbourhoods of beachfront villas. Sandy beaches and sheltered coves run along the fronds, and landscaped streets with shaded walkways and cycling routes connect the neighbourhoods. Bluewaters Island, Palm Jumeirah, Burj Al Arab and Mall of the Emirates lie further along the coast towards central Dubai.

A dedicated highway links the island directly to Sheikh Zayed Road, the main route between central Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Life Pharmacy Metro Station and Ibn Battuta Mall are the nearest transit and retail points on the mainland, with Dubai Marina, Expo City Dubai and Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC) within easy driving distance and Dubai International Airport (DXB) further across the city. On the island itself, the masterplan provides for hotels and resorts, lifestyle malls, beach clubs, a yacht club, leisure parks and a waterfront promenade, so that many everyday needs can be met close to home.

Palm Jebel Ali extends the palm-island concept that shaped Palm Jumeirah to the western side of the Dubai coastline, with a strong focus on beachfront living. Nakheel reports strong demand for beachfront homes on the island, and the combination of direct beach access, resort-style facilities and a planned hospitality cluster appeals both to end users looking for a home by the sea and to investors targeting the rental market. Its position between Dubai Marina and Al Maktoum International Airport keeps the island within reach of both established coastal districts and Expo City Dubai.
